newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries seen opening thinly traded, data due.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries seen opening thinly traded, data due.

text.p: The prices of U.S. government securities were expected to open thinly traded in a shortened trading session Tuesday, following largely lifeless overnight trading overseas.

However, traders warn there could be some reaction to new home sales and the Chicago Purchasing Managers survey, both scheduled for 1000EST/1500GMT release. In addition, comsumer confidence numbers are officially slated for 900EST/1400GMT release, but these figures often leak out as early as 830EST/1330GMT, traders said.
